question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Unity
solution:
The correct answer is "**Discord**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonyms are words that have opposite meanings.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **"Unity" means the state of being together or joined as a whole.**(एकता)
 
 
• ​Example: There is strength in unity.
 
 
 
• **Discord is the opposite of unity, meaning disagreement or lack of harmony.**(फूट)
 
 
• Example: Going to school amplified the discord of my mind.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, discord is the most appropriate antonym of unity.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Invade means to enter forcefully or aggressively. It is not related to the meaning of unity.(आक्रमण)
 
• Option 2: Illegible means difficult or impossible to read. It is not related to the meaning of unity.(अस्पष्ट)
 
• Option 3: Illogical means lacking sense or reasoning. It is not related to the meaning of unity.(विसंगत)
